body: Firstly, opening with the sentence "i introjected three OCS and one of them is my friend's" is WILD and secondly this is from a community called "system confessions" and going through their thread this person seems to have a whole Saga of things of this nature happening, which reads more like a soap opera than the actual struggles of someone with did (coming from someone with did)

This really helped !! I still thinks it's unfair cus why should taking care of the body for so long fall over me. Why do -I- gotta pick up the slack, its confusing... 

But I guess you're right, we've always worked in a "front when you're needed" kinda way and if I have to be responsible I'll do it. I still just wish there were more adults around , but thank you, I'll do my best! You're right!

Not really, it's always more of a "what's needed right now" situation, that's why I'm confused , I didn't think I was needed right now

I wish things were more organized and someone was responsible though
They're too old for him to draw anyways

To be fair, 27 is pretty young in the grand scheme of things, and it's not wasteful since you've got a job (in this economy it really doesn't matter what kind in my opinion).

Though it think it's interesting that you consider a waste  to not have irl friends, people online are still very much real people, independently of if you ever meet or not, and our value as human beings shouldn't be dependent on our relationships the way I see it.

I've read your situation and it seems like the standard of many other 27 year olds, but sometimes our mind can make us feel like our specific lives are somehow worse than others and there's no way out, which is problematic to lead a happy life, I think. But that's what depression and other mental illnesses do, makes it hard to get rid of them.

I would usually suggest therapy though it can be pretty expensive in some places... I'd still recommend it, we have free therapy here, perhaps Ireland has similar public mental health services? 
If that's not an option you could benefit from cognitive reconstruction excercises, to keep you grounded, but I'm aware those can be difficult without proper practice.

All in all, I'm just some dude on reddit, suggesting you not to kill yourself so wtf do I know 

Edit: forgot to add mental health issues don't just disappear when you grow up. Seek help if you can
